create_roberta_tokenizer: create a RobertaTokenizer instance from a pretrained model name like FacebookAI/roberta-base
build_roberta_tokenizer_custom_vocab: build a RobertaTokenizer with custom vocabulary and merges files for domain-specific tokenization
test_roberta_tokenizer_encoding: test the RobertaTokenizer encoding by passing text and retrieving input_ids with add_prefix_space
refactor_roberta_tokenizer_special_token: refactor the RobertaTokenizer to use custom special tokens for bos, eos, sep, cls, unk, pad, and mask
review_roberta_tokenizer_bytelevel_bpe: review the RobertaTokenizer ByteLevel pre-tokenizer and BPE model configuration with RobertaProcessing post-processor
